description.text: The International Business major studies the laws and practices of international business activities such as international trade, international investment, and multinational enterprise management, and is closely related to international economics and trade, international finance, business administration and logistics management, and has typical interdisciplinary professional characteristics. The master's degree in international business requires equal emphasis on theoretical learning and practical teaching outside the university, emphasizing the use of advanced teaching concepts and methods such as team learning, case analysis and on-site research, and focusing on the expansion and application of macro thinking and economic theory in international business relations and the cultivation of operational skills. In the long-term teaching and research practice, this major has formed a faculty team with high teaching and research level and reasonable age structure, which has been engaged in theoretical and applied research of international business and related disciplines for a long time, and has achieved a series of high-quality research results in the direction of import and export trade, regional economic cooperation, international direct investment and international logistics management. There are 22 supervisors, including 11 professors, 5 associate professors and 19 doctoral degree teachers; Hire 8 off-campus part-time tutors from enterprises and institutions. This major cultivates students with good professional ethics and social responsibility, international vision, familiar with the basic theories of modern international business, and mastering international business professional skills; Strong cross-cultural communication skills and international business decision-making skills; Competent for foreign-related enterprises, financial institutions, government departments, etc. engaged in international trade, international investment and financing, international business operation, international enterprise management, etc.; High-level talents of applied compound modern international business with management execution, information processing, innovation and entrepreneurship capabilities.

duration.text: The International Business at Jiangsu Ocean University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1666 USD/per year ￥ 12000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Application Form2. Scanned front (information) page of passport3. Graduation certificate, Certificate of undergraduate degree4. Official academic transcripts of undergraduate degree5. Certificate HSK4/Certificate of sufficiency of English (IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 60 or a corresponding level of English proficiency) (if the courses are taught in English)6. Recommendation letters from two professors7. Study plan8. Certificate of deposit (minimum $2,000 bank slip)9. Foreigner Physical Examination Form valid in half year10. Certificate of non-criminal record

requirements.text: Preparatory Program: High School Diploma and beyond or Equivalent Undergraduate Programs: High School Diploma and beyond or Equivalent Master’s Degree Programs: Undergraduate Degree or Equivalent
